task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal window showing the contents of ~/Documents/observing_queue.txt with targets M44, NGC 2392, and M51.

task_completion.description: Agent configures and executes exposures for M44 (Beehive Cluster).
task_completion.visual_evidence: KStars/Ekos CCD module showing target M44 with B and V filters selected and progress on 10 total exposures.

task_completion.description: Agent configures and executes exposures for NGC 2392 (Eskimo Nebula).
task_completion.visual_evidence: KStars/Ekos CCD module showing target NGC 2392 with Ha and OIII filters selected and progress on 6 total exposures.

task_completion.description: Agent configures and executes exposures for M51 (Whirlpool Galaxy).
task_completion.visual_evidence: KStars/Ekos CCD module showing target M51 with Luminance and R filters selected and progress on 8 total exposures.

task_completion.description: Agent captures a final sky view image to the specified path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file manager or image viewer showing an image saved at ~/Images/queue/final_sky.png.

task_completion.description: Agent creates a session log documenting the completed observations.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal showing the creation/content of ~/Documents/session_log.txt mentioning the three targets.

integrity.description: The agent used the KStars/Ekos GUI to control the telescope and CCD rather than just creating dummy files via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with KStars/Ekos buttons (Slew, Capture, Filter selection) and the INDI control panel.

integrity.description: The agent waited for actual exposures to complete in the simulator.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots show the progress bar in the Ekos CCD module increasing or the 'Images Received' count incrementing.

integrity.description: The agent manually typed or generated the log based on the session rather than copying a hidden solution.
integrity.visual_evidence: The session log content reflects the specific order and details of the actions taken during the recorded trajectory.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The observing queue contains three targets: M44 (requires 10 exposures: 5 B, 5 V), NGC 2392 (requires 6 exposures: 3 Ha, 3 OIII), and M51 (requires 8 exposures: 4 Luminance, 4 R). The agent must use the KStars/Ekos interface to slew to these targets and capture the specified frames. The final sky view must be saved as ~/Images/queue/final_sky.png and the log as ~/Documents/session_log.txt.
